verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI is a Python agent framework whose agents run without a UI. The docs describe agents running on a durable background queue or as a plain object you call run() on. They also provide TestModel/FunctionModel for testing and code-run eval suites, all of which fit headless automation. missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline documentation (e.g., GitHub Actions/exit-code guidance), a non-interactive clai invocation mode, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
